title: Cross-sectional momentum on NIFTY 200, long only
hypothesis: Stocks with the highest past 6- or 12-month returns (skipping the latest month) in the point-in-time NIFTY 200 earn more, after 2026 delivery charges, than the equal-weighted NIFTY 200 over the next one to three months.

mechanism.text: Under-reaction to news and slow diffusion, then herding; partly a reward for crash risk when losers rebound.

evidence.source: Jegadeesh and Titman, Journal of Finance 48(1)
evidence.finding: Winners minus losers over 3-12 months earn about 1% a month.

evidence.source: Agarwalla, Jacob and Varma, IIM Ahmedabad W.P. 2013-09-05 and data library
evidence.finding: Momentum factor about 21.9% a year, 1994-2014, the strongest Indian factor.

evidence.source: NSE Indices, Nifty200 Momentum 30 methodology (launched Aug 2020, base 2005)
evidence.finding: About 4 points a year over the parent since 2005, mostly back-tested; about 32% drawdown Sep 2024 to Mar 2025.

evidence.source: Daniel and Moskowitz, Journal of Financial Economics 122(2)
evidence.finding: Momentum crashes in rebounds after bear markets.

universe.name: nifty200-pit
universe.rule: Members of NIFTY 200 on each rebalance date, from NSE's dated constituent changes; at least 252 sessions of history.

turnover.basis: monthly: about 35% one-way turnover a month x 0.33% CNC round trip; quarterly is lower

prior_trials.basis: No cross-sectional rule has been run in this repo.

holdout_rule.pass_if: Holdout active return over the equal-weighted point-in-time universe above zero after charges, its Sharpe above zero, and the deepest active drawdown under 20%.

kill_criteria: Holdout active return at or below zero after charges.
More than half of the total active return from the best two months.
Fewer than half of the grid neighbourhood with positive active return in validation.
Benjamini-Hochberg across the programme at q = 0.10 does not keep it.

prior.reason: Best-documented anomaly, strong in Indian data; long-only and crowded by index funds, crash risk shown in 2024-25.

feasibility.reason: Needs point-in-time membership and 15 years of adjusted prices (#71) and a portfolio engine (#72).

contamination: Discovery's 527 daily rule trials and the equity library ran on about 2.3 years of daily bars (2024 to 2026) of NIFTY 50 stocks: single-stock timing rules, not this cross-sectional rule. No cross-sectional portfolio has been run on any part of this span in this repo.
